🔍 PatternRecognition

A sequence of shapes, numbers, or colors appears, and you must identify the underlying pattern to predict what comes next. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Study the sequence and identify the pattern rule.
  2. Click on or select the item that continues the pattern correctly.
  3. Common patterns: arithmetic sequence, geometric, alternating, Fibonacci.
  4. Some sequences combine multiple pattern types.
  5. Think flexibly — the pattern might be visual, numerical, or both.
